correctness.rationale: All chord-normal directions are exactly the 14 vectors at multiples of pi/7, with alternating support heights 1 and cos(pi/7). Tightening gives a finite exhaustive list. A support polygon with four active lines has the displayed support-area identity, proved by summing edge lengths. Exact rational trigonometric interval certification checks all 511 bounded four-normal subsets; seven have the unique minimum and each other formal value is greater by 1/40. Redundant lines yield a triangle, whose area is at least 3sqrt(3)cos(pi/7)^2>4.05, strictly larger than the winning area <3.5. Affine invariance and equality classification then follow. The standalone certificate was executed directly from its packaged path.
